---
title: "`r params$title`"
author: "`r params$author`"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output:
  html_document:
    self_contained: true
    toc: true
    toc_float: true
    theme: flatly
    code_folding: hide
params:
  seurat_obj: NULL
  comp_group: "comparison"
  author: "Pipeline"
  title: "QC Report"
  out_dir: "."

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
has_plotly <- requireNamespace("plotly", quietly = TRUE)
if (has_plotly) {
  plotly_dependencies <- htmltools::findDependencies(plotly::plot_ly())
  plotly_main <- Filter(function(dep) identical(dep$name, "plotly-main"),
                        plotly_dependencies)
  has_plotly <- length(plotly_main) == 1L && file.exists(file.path(
    plotly_main[[1L]]$src$file, plotly_main[[1L]]$script
  ))
}

.interactive_plot <- function(plot) {
  if (has_plotly) {
    plotly::ggplotly(plot, tooltip = "text") |>
      plotly::config(displayModeBar = TRUE, scrollZoom = TRUE)
  } else {
    plot
  }
}

.qc_umap_plot <- function(obj, color_by, title) {
  embedding <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(obj, "umap"))
  if (ncol(embedding) < 2L) return(NULL)
  embedding <- embedding[, 1:2, drop = FALSE]
  names(embedding) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")
  embedding$cell <- rownames(embedding)
  embedding$group <- as.character(obj@meta.data[[color_by]])
  p <- ggplot(embedding, aes(
    UMAP_1, UMAP_2, color = group,
    text = paste("Cell:", cell, "<br>", color_by, ":", group)
  )) +
    geom_point(size = 0.6, alpha = 0.75) +
    labs(title = title, x = "UMAP 1", y = "UMAP 2", color = color_by) +
    theme_minimal()
  .interactive_plot(p)
}

# `%||%` is exported by SPARKS but is not on the search path when the package is
# only loaded (SPARKS::sparks()), and base R only has it from 4.4.0.
if (!exists("%||%", mode = "function")) {
  `%||%` <- function(lhs, rhs) if (is.null(lhs) || length(lhs) == 0L) rhs else lhs
}
```

```{r load-obj}
obj <- params$seurat_obj
if (is.null(obj)) stop("No Seurat object provided")
group  <- params$comp_group
out_dir <- params$out_dir
cfg    <- params$cfg   # may be NULL when report is rendered standalone
```

# QC Report: `r group`

## Report guide

This report summarizes post-filtering data quality for **`r group`**. Use the table of contents to navigate the dataset summary, input and filtering details, QC metrics, doublet and scoring summaries, clustering, session information, and pipeline diagnostics.

```{r report-at-a-glance}
qc_summary <- data.frame(
  Item = c("Comparison group", "Cells after filtering", "Genes",
           "Samples", "Conditions", "QC metrics available"),
  Value = c(
    group,
    format(ncol(obj), big.mark = ","),
    format(nrow(obj), big.mark = ","),
    if ("orig.ident" %in% colnames(obj[[]]))
      length(unique(obj$orig.ident)) else "Not available",
    if ("condition" %in% colnames(obj[[]]))
      length(unique(obj$condition)) else "Not available",
    paste(intersect(c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                    colnames(obj[[]])), collapse = ", ")
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
print(kable(qc_summary, col.names = c("Summary item", "Value")))
```

## QC metrics after filtering

### Per-sample QC summary

```{r qc-summary-by-sample, results='asis'}
qc_summary_cols <- intersect(c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent.mt"),
                             colnames(obj@meta.data))
qc_group_col <- if ("orig.ident" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) "orig.ident" else
  if ("condition" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) "condition" else NULL

if (length(qc_summary_cols) && !is.null(qc_group_col)) {
  qc_summary_long <- obj@meta.data |>
    dplyr::mutate(.group = as.character(.data[[qc_group_col]])) |>
    tidyr::pivot_longer(dplyr::all_of(qc_summary_cols),
                        names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") |>
    dplyr::group_by(.group, Metric) |>
    dplyr::summarise(
      Cells = sum(!is.na(Value)),
      Median = if (any(!is.na(Value))) stats::median(Value, na.rm = TRUE) else NA_real_,
      Q1 = if (any(!is.na(Value))) stats::quantile(Value, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE) else NA_real_,
      Q3 = if (any(!is.na(Value))) stats::quantile(Value, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE, names = FALSE) else NA_real_,
      .groups = "drop"
    ) |>
    dplyr::rename(Group = .group)
  qc_summary_long[c("Median", "Q1", "Q3")] <- lapply(
    qc_summary_long[c("Median", "Q1", "Q3")], round, digits = 2
  )
  print(kable(qc_summary_long, caption = paste("QC summary by", qc_group_col),
              row.names = FALSE))
} else {
  cat("> Per-sample QC summary is unavailable because sample/condition grouping or QC metrics are missing.\n")
}
```

### Filtering outcomes and sample-level diagnostics

```{r stage-counts, results='asis'}
qc_roots <- unique(c(
  out_dir,
  file.path(dirname(dirname(out_dir)), "Sample_QC")
))
qc_roots <- qc_roots[dir.exists(qc_roots)]
qc_files <- unique(c(
  params$run_files,
  unlist(lapply(qc_roots, list.files, recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE),
         use.names = FALSE)
))
qc_files <- qc_files[!is.na(qc_files) & file.exists(qc_files)]
count_files <- qc_files[grepl(
  "^(before|after)_filtering_.*_cell_counts[.]txt$", basename(qc_files)
)]

read_total_cells <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  total <- grep("^Total cells:", lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(total)) {
    return(suppressWarnings(as.integer(sub("^Total cells:[[:space:]]*", "",
                                           total[[1L]]))))
  }
  if (any(grepl("No cells remaining", lines, fixed = TRUE))) return(0L)
  NA_integer_
}

if (length(count_files)) {
  count_data <- data.frame(
    File = basename(count_files),
    Cells = vapply(count_files, read_total_cells, integer(1)),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  count_data$Stage <- ifelse(grepl("^before_filtering_", count_data$File),
                             "Before cell filtering", "After QC and doublet removal")
  count_data$Sample <- sub(
    "^(before|after)_filtering_(.*)_cell_counts[.]txt$", "\\2",
    count_data$File
  )
  count_wide <- tidyr::pivot_wider(
    count_data[, c("Sample", "Stage", "Cells")],
    names_from = "Stage", values_from = "Cells"
  )
  before_col <- "Before cell filtering"
  after_col <- "After QC and doublet removal"
  if (!before_col %in% names(count_wide)) count_wide[[before_col]] <- NA_integer_
  if (!after_col %in% names(count_wide)) count_wide[[after_col]] <- NA_integer_
  count_wide$Retained <- ifelse(
    !is.na(count_wide[[before_col]]) & count_wide[[before_col]] > 0,
    round(100 * count_wide[[after_col]] / count_wide[[before_col]], 1), NA_real_
  )
  names(count_wide)[names(count_wide) == "Retained"] <- "Retained cells (%)"
  print(kable(count_wide, caption = "Cell retention by sample",
              row.names = FALSE))
} else {
  cat("> Per-sample filtering counts are unavailable for this run.\n")
}

qc_plots <- qc_files[grepl(
  "^(VlnPlot|FeatureScatter)_(preFiltering|postFiltering)_.*[.]png$",
  basename(qc_files)
)]
if (length(qc_plots)) {
  cat("\nPre-filtering and post-filtering QC plots are shown where available.\n")
  for (plot_path in sort(qc_plots)) {
    cat("\n**", basename(plot_path), "**\n\n", sep = "")
    print(knitr::include_graphics(normalizePath(plot_path, winslash = "/")))
  }
} else {
  cat("> Per-sample pre/post-filtering plot files are not available.\n")
}
```

### Alevin barcode-level diagnostics

When Alevin's barcode-frequency and feature-dump files are available, these
plots summarize barcode selection and per-barcode quantification. They are
omitted for other input formats or when the relevant Alevin output files were
not generated.

```{r alevin-diagnostics, fig.width=10, fig.height=5, results='asis'}
alevin_data <- NULL
if (!is.null(cfg)) {
  sample_table <- tryCatch(SPARKS::load_sample_table(cfg),
                           error = function(e) NULL)
  data_dir <- cfg$pipeline$data_dir %||% NULL
  if (!is.null(sample_table) && !is.null(data_dir)) {
    group_col <- if ("comparison_group" %in% names(sample_table)) {
      sample_table$comparison_group == group
    } else rep(FALSE, nrow(sample_table))
    samples <- sample_table[group_col, , drop = FALSE]
    loaded <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(samples)), function(i) {
      sample <- samples[i, , drop = FALSE]
      format <- if ("quant_format" %in% names(sample) &&
                    !is.na(sample$quant_format[1L]) &&
                    nzchar(sample$quant_format[1L])) {
        as.character(sample$quant_format[1L])
      } else cfg$input$format %||% "auto"
      sample_dir <- file.path(data_dir, sample$folder_id[1L])
      if (identical(format, "auto")) {
        format <- tryCatch(SPARKS:::.detect_quant_format(sample_dir),
                           error = function(e) NA_character_)
      }
      if (!identical(format, "alevin")) return(NULL)

      alevin_dir <- file.path(sample_dir, "alevin")
      frequency_file <- file.path(alevin_dir, "raw_cb_frequency.txt")
      feature_file <- file.path(alevin_dir, "featureDump.txt")
      if (!file.exists(frequency_file) || !file.exists(feature_file)) return(NULL)

      frequency <- tryCatch(utils::read.delim(
        frequency_file, header = FALSE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        col.names = c("CB", "originalFreq"), comment.char = ""
      ), error = function(e) NULL)
      features <- tryCatch(utils::read.delim(
        feature_file, header = TRUE, sep = "\t", stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        check.names = FALSE, comment.char = ""
      ), error = function(e) NULL)
      if (is.null(frequency) || is.null(features) ||
          !"CB" %in% names(features)) return(NULL)

      aliases <- c(MappingRate = "mappingRate", CorrectedReads = "collapsedFreq",
                   DedupRate = "dedupRate", NumGenesOverMean = "nbrGenesAboveMean",
                   MappedReads = "nbrMappedUMI",
                   DeduplicatedReads = "totalUMICount",
                   NumGenesExpressed = "nbrGenesAboveZero")
      rename_from <- intersect(names(aliases), names(features))
      names(features)[match(rename_from, names(features))] <- unname(aliases[rename_from])
      keep <- intersect(c("CB", "collapsedFreq", "totalUMICount",
                          "nbrGenesAboveZero", "mappingRate"), names(features))
      merged <- merge(frequency, features[, keep, drop = FALSE], by = "CB")
      if (!nrow(merged)) return(NULL)
      merged$Sample <- paste(sample$protocol[1L], sample$folder_id[1L], sep = "_")
      merged$ranking <- rank(-merged$originalFreq, ties.method = "first")
      whitelist <- file.path(alevin_dir, "whitelist.txt")
      merged$inWhitelist <- if (file.exists(whitelist)) {
        whitelist_ids <- utils::read.delim(whitelist, header = FALSE,
                                           stringsAsFactors = FALSE)[[1L]]
        merged$CB %in% whitelist_ids
      } else FALSE
      merged
    })
    loaded <- Filter(Negate(is.null), loaded)
    if (length(loaded)) alevin_data <- do.call(rbind, loaded)
  }
}

if (is.null(alevin_data) || !nrow(alevin_data)) {
  cat("> Alevin barcode-level output files are unavailable for this group.\n")
} else {
  freq_data <- alevin_data[is.finite(alevin_data$originalFreq) &
                           alevin_data$originalFreq > 0, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(freq_data)) {
    p <- ggplot(freq_data, aes(
      ranking, originalFreq, color = inWhitelist,
      text = paste("Sample:", Sample, "<br>Barcode rank:", ranking,
                   "<br>Raw frequency:", originalFreq,
                   "<br>In final whitelist:", inWhitelist)
    )) +
      geom_line() +
      scale_x_log10() + scale_y_log10() +
      facet_wrap(~ Sample, scales = "free") +
      labs(title = "Raw barcode frequency rank",
           x = "Barcode rank (log scale)", y = "Raw read frequency (log scale)",
           color = "In whitelist") +
      theme_minimal()
    .interactive_plot(p)
  }

  if (all(c("collapsedFreq", "totalUMICount") %in% names(alevin_data))) {
    quant_data <- alevin_data[
      is.finite(alevin_data$collapsedFreq) & alevin_data$collapsedFreq > 0 &
        is.finite(alevin_data$totalUMICount) & alevin_data$totalUMICount > 0,
      , drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (nrow(quant_data)) {
      p <- ggplot(quant_data, aes(
        collapsedFreq, totalUMICount, color = inWhitelist,
        text = paste("Sample:", Sample, "<br>Barcode frequency:", collapsedFreq,
                     "<br>UMIs:", totalUMICount)
      )) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.7) +
        facet_wrap(~ Sample, scales = "free") +
        labs(title = "Barcode frequency and UMI quantification",
             x = "Collapsed barcode frequency", y = "Total UMI count",
             color = "In whitelist") +
        theme_minimal()
      .interactive_plot(p)
    }
  }

  if (all(c("totalUMICount", "nbrGenesAboveZero") %in% names(alevin_data))) {
    gene_data <- alevin_data[
      is.finite(alevin_data$totalUMICount) & alevin_data$totalUMICount > 0 &
        is.finite(alevin_data$nbrGenesAboveZero) &
        alevin_data$nbrGenesAboveZero > 0, , drop = FALSE
    ]
    if (nrow(gene_data)) {
      p <- ggplot(gene_data, aes(
        totalUMICount, nbrGenesAboveZero, color = inWhitelist,
        text = paste("Sample:", Sample, "<br>UMIs:", totalUMICount,
                     "<br>Detected genes:", nbrGenesAboveZero)
      )) +
        geom_point(alpha = 0.5, size = 0.7) +
        facet_wrap(~ Sample, scales = "free") +
        labs(title = "Detected genes by barcode-level UMI count",
             x = "Total UMI count", y = "Detected genes",
             color = "In whitelist") +
        theme_minimal()
      .interactive_plot(p)
    }
  }
}
```

## Pipeline diagnostics

```{r diagnostics, results='asis'}
if (!is.null(params$log_path) && file.exists(params$log_path)) {
  log_lines <- readLines(params$log_path, warn = FALSE)
  diagnostics <- grep("\\[(WARNING|ERROR)\\]", log_lines, value = TRUE)
  skips <- grep("\\[SKIP", log_lines, value = TRUE)
  if (length(diagnostics) || length(skips)) {
    diagnostic_df <- data.frame(
      Type = c(rep("Warning/error", length(diagnostics)),
               rep("Skipped/unavailable", length(skips))),
      Message = c(diagnostics, skips),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    print(kable(diagnostic_df))
  } else {
    cat("No warnings, errors, or skipped analyses were logged.")
  }
} else {
  cat("Pipeline log is not available.")
}
```
